files.description: Order lines (300 rows): line_id (whole number), product (product name; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), quantity (whole number; about 3% empty), amount (line total, two decimals; about 3% empty).

task_text: Give the total quantity and the total amount over all order lines, ignoring empty cells. `result` should be a Series with the two totals, indexed by quantity and amount.
intended_computation: Column sums of quantity and amount over the non-empty cells of all 300 lines; two values.

predicted_direction.reason: np.sum on a DataFrame gave per-column totals on 2.x; on 3.x it adds up both columns into one number.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row I01; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
